summary.en: The Burkina Faso junta reinstated the death penalty and secured pilot training from a Czech state firm while its army and Russia's Africa Corps committed new abuses against civilians. In northern Niger, gunmen attacked buses, killing at least 12 people. In Mali, Islamic State militants killed at least 48 civilians in Ménaka and separate gunmen attacks killed over 40 civilians, while a court in Mopti tried 69 soldiers for alleged crimes. The conflict produced 4,159 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Burkina Fasos militærjunta gjeninnførte dødsstraff og sikret pilotopplæring fra et tsjekkisk statlig firma, mens hæren og Russlands Africa Corps begikk nye overgrep mot sivile. I Nord-Niger angrep væpnede menn busser og drepte minst 12 personer. I Mali drepte IS-militante minst 48 sivile i Ménaka, og separate væpnede-mann-angrep drepte over 40 sivile, mens en domstol i Mopti prøvde 69 soldater for påståtte forbrytelser. Konflikten førte til 4 159 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: War in the Sahel
background.extract: The War in the Sahel, also known synonymously as the Sahel War is a multi-sided armed conflict that has been ongoing since 2012. In particular, the intensive conflict mainly takes place in the three countries of Mali, Niger and Burkina Faso.
